items.title: Trump plays with a critical lifeline that keeps global economy going
items.summary: A potential US diesel export ban could worsen an already tight global fuel market by removing about 1.2 million barrels a day of supply at a time when Middle Eastern, Russian and Chinese exports are constrained. Europe would be particularly exposed, while India could gain export opportunities for its refiners but also face higher crude and domestic fuel costs as global buyers compete for scarce diesel.

items.title: RBI MPC Meeting October 2026: Repo rate hike soon? Date, announcement time, members, monetary policy review expectations
items.summary: The RBI is likely to adopt a calibrated tightening approach after a 50 bps hike, responding to firm economic activity and rising inflation. A 25 bps increase to 5.50% could occur at the October meeting, driven by heightened price pressures and global rate changes.

items.title: Bargain Britain lures foreign buyers as hostile takeovers surge
items.summary: International capital is driving a surge in public takeovers in the G7’s fastest-growing economy.

items.title: Eurozone inflation hits its highest level in three years at 3.8% as energy costs soar
items.summary: Annual euro zone inflation hit 3.8% last month, its highest level since September 2023.

items.title: Taiwan index ends at record high, surges 65% year-to-date - What’s driving the rally?
items.summary: The Taiwan Weighted Index (TAIEX) has reached a fresh closing high, surging 65% year-to-date amid a booming AI and semiconductor market. From record exports to a tech-driven GDP growth, discover the compelling forces driving this remarkable rally.

items.title: U.S. urges Europe to ‘immediately’ release diesel reserves as Iran war fuels record prices
items.summary: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.

items.title: Oil prices fall over 3% on report of potential diesel, crude stock release; Brent back below $100
items.summary: It comes after Reuters reported that EU nations were discussing a proposal to release diesel reserves following pressure from the Trump administration.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh commercial tax collections rise 18 pc to Rs 30,436 cr in H1
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh’s commercial tax collections rose 18% year-on-year to Rs 30,435.98 crore during April-September 2026, with September recording the highest monthly collection so far. Net GST collections increased 18% to Rs 19,635.49 crore in the first half of FY 2026-27, while September net GST rose 14.10%. The state attributed the growth to stronger compliance, enforcement, economic activity and technology-led tax monitoring.

items.title: Shyam Metalics signs deal to invest over $5 billion in Maharashtra state
items.summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy has signed an agreement with the Maharashtra government for a significant investment. This investment will establish a greenfield steel complex in Chandrapur with a capacity of 9 million metric tonnes per year. The project is expected to create approximately 30,000 jobs, which includes both direct and indirect employment. Operations for the new steel plant are anticipated to commence in the ongoing financial year, pending necessary approvals.

items.title: Indian chemical sector recovery begins, but return on capital may take 2-3 years to recover: Equirus
items.summary: India's chemicals sector is showing signs of recovery after a downturn in recent years. Median revenue across 72 listed companies grew by 22 percent year-on-year in the first quarter of FY27. However, established and newly commissioned plants operate at low capacity utilisation rates, influencing recovery speed. The long-term demand for India's specialty chemicals market remains strong despite the cyclical downturn.

items.title: 'I am hurt, but my hope and determination remain; I still have dreams' - EaseMyTrip founder Nishant Pitti
items.summary: EaseMyTrip founder and chairman Nishant Pitti said 'the past few days have hurt deeply' after the Patiala House Court in Delhi granted an interim injunction directing removal of publications he described as offending.

items.title: China fuel export suspension to choke supplies in Asia
items.summary: China's recent export restrictions on oil products have affected several major importers in Southeast Asia and Australia. Singapore has seen a significant drop in gasoline imports from China this year, while Australia remains a key destination for jet fuel imports. The situation has led to increased pricing pressures as Asian refiners respond to tighter supplies. Local authorities in Australia affirm that current fuel stock levels are adequate despite these changes.

items.title: Brazil votes in high-stakes election as U.S.-China rivalry and debt loom large
items.summary: Brazil will hold a knife-edge vote as its presidential race kicks off — but the election's outcome is likely to be felt far beyond the country's borders.

items.title: Investors worried over bloodbath as Nifty 50 sees longest weekly losing streak in 25 yrs - Outlook for H2 from experts
items.summary: Indian equity markets faced an eighth consecutive week of losses, with the Nifty 50 and  Sensex declining 3.1% and 2.7%, respectively. Foreign institutional investors sold equities worth ₹44,012.82 crore, the highest since June 2026, exacerbating market volatility and negative investor sentiment.

items.title: From barren desert to red gold: Saffron cultivation debuts in Ladakh
items.summary: Ladakh has launched a pilot to grow high-value saffron on restored barren land in Leh, planting about 90,000 Iranian saffron corms across 4,000 square metres at Spituk Pharka. If successful, the project could diversify cold-desert agriculture and create a new income source for local farmers, youth and self-help groups.

items.title: Amazon Now doubles footprint to 120+ cities ahead of festive season
items.summary: Amazon has recently expanded its ultra-fast delivery service, Amazon Now, to more than 120 cities in India. This expansion aims to enhance its delivery network ahead of the upcoming festive season. The service now offers a wide range of products, fulfilling orders through nearly 800 fulfilment centres nationwide. Customers can access special deals during the Amazon Great Indian Festival, beginning October 8.

items.title: FPO-led food exports from Haryana to Canada open new market opportunities for farmers
items.summary: A 24-metric-tonne consignment of frozen food products from Haryana has been exported to Canada by Aterna Foods Producer Company Limited, marking an effort to connect Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) with international markets. The shipment, valued at CAD 35,140, includes frozen peas, mixed vegetables, sweet corn, peas and carrots and samosas. APEDA facilitated the export under its Financial Assistance Scheme.

items.title: TCS, Wipro, Infosys, HCL Tech: Why experts see IT stocks' price jump on Monday — What's giving the boost?
items.summary: Accenture's better-than-expected results is a big positive development for the Indian IT majors, say experts

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Decoding the new investment landscape and shift in smart money
items.summary: Transformations in the global economy are reshaping how investors allocate capital and devise strategies. Geopolitical conflicts and tech rivalries are challenging conventional wisdom, leading to heightened interest in markets such as India, Southeast Asia, and the Gulf states. Strategic investments in infrastructure and commodities have gained importance. The upcoming ET Alpha Wealth Summit aims to delve into these transformative investment trends.

items.title: US pressures Europe to release diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
items.summary: President Donald Trump has threatened to ban diesel exports in a bid to ease prices in the US ahead of the November elections.

items.title: Railway Assistant Loco Pilot CBT-2 result 2026 released: Check who made it to the next stage, merit list PDF, cut-off marks and CBAT date
items.summary: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the ALP CBT-2 Result 2026 for candidates who appeared for the Assistant Loco Pilot examination held on July 28. Candidates can check the merit list and zone-wise cut-off marks on their respective RRB regional websites. Those who qualify will appear for the Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) scheduled for October 30, while the scorecard download facility will remain available until October 16.

items.title: Nike lays a big long-term bet on India with new Bengaluru campus to serve athletes and drive growth
items.summary: Nike Inc plans to open a new campus in Bengaluru by FY28 to strengthen its operations in India. This campus will be crucial for supporting Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands. The decision is part of Nike's broader strategy to enhance global growth and manufacturing capabilities. The location of the campus will be disclosed next calendar year.

items.title: 66% returns in 6 months, small-cap stock Rolex Rings gets Buy rating: InCred sees 32% upside - Check share price target
items.summary: InCred praises Rolex Rings for strong potential growth, forecasting revenue and EBITDA increases up to FY28, with an expected 28% price upside to INR 251. The outlook is buoyed by recovering US exports, rising European business, and enhanced domestic demand for bearing rings.

items.title: Goldman bought Shein shares worth $220mn after dismal IPO
items.summary: Shares in fast-fashion retailer have tumbled 38% since listing in Hong Kong last month

items.title: European shares edge higher after bonds-driven selloff, focus on inflation data
items.summary: Following a sharp selloff, European stocks made a modest recovery, influenced by recent shifts in the bond market. Investors are keeping a close eye on upcoming euro zone inflation data that could steer monetary policy. Additionally, the US nonfarm payrolls figures are eagerly awaited, with estimates suggesting an increase of 90,000 jobs for September.

items.title: Airbus delivered around 72 aircraft in September, sources say
items.summary: Airbus's aircraft deliveries in September were reported to be around 72, close to last year's total of 73. Industry experts had estimated deliveries to be in the mid to high 60s range. This increase follows concerns about delays from various industrial issues affecting production. Commercial CEO Lars Wagner expressed confidence in meeting the full-year delivery target of around 870 jets.

items.title: Hindalco calls off AluChem acquisition amid prolonged closing delays
items.summary: Hindalco Industries Ltd has decided to terminate its USD 125 million acquisition of AluChem Companies Inc. The cancellation follows extended delays in closing the transaction, affecting both parties involved. Hindalco maintains its strategy for expanding the speciality alumina business remains unchanged despite this setback. AluChem will continue operating independently, serving its customer base as it has for nearly five decades.

items.title: OpenAI fires workers for 'mishandling sensitive information'
items.summary: The former employees were investigated for sharing data with an outside AI evaluation group.

items.title: Piyush Goyal says India does not have structural excess manufacturing capacity
items.summary: Piyush Goyal said India does not have structural excess manufacturing capacity in sectors identified by the G20, arguing that Indian production caters to both domestic and global demand. Speaking at the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting in the US, Goyal also stressed WTO rules, supply-chain diversification, forced labour concerns and the need to preserve policy space for developing economies.

items.title: UN climate chief hails India's Green Energy Corridor-III, says grid strengthening will deliver "big dividends"
items.summary: India’s Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III has won backing from the UN’s top climate official, who said stronger grids and battery storage could boost energy security, jobs and economic growth. The scheme aims to enable evacuation of about 135 GW of renewable power, deploy 50 GWh of battery storage and support India’s 500 GW non-fossil capacity target for 2030.

items.title: Final touch underway for Jio Platforms IPO; latest GMP, expected launch date, size, valuation, shareholders quota
items.summary: Jio Platforms is finalising its IPO documents for what may be India's largest public offering, estimated at $3.8 billion. Led by Akash Ambani, the IPO marks Reliance's first offering since 2008 and aims to engage global investors before a late 2026 market launch.

items.title: Nifty 500 stocks fall up to 70% from 52-week highs; why broad market recovery may remain elusive in short term
items.summary: The Nifty 500 index has faced a significant downturn, with stocks plummeting by up to 70% from their 52-week highs. A blend of geopolitical tensions, escalating oil prices, and weak monsoon predictions is a contributing factor.

items.title: Inox Air Products files draft papers for initial offer
items.summary: INOX Air Products, an integrated industrial, medical, electronic and specialty gases company, has filed DRHP with Sebi for launching an IPO.

items.title: Carlsberg India unit, 3 other firms get Sebi nod to proceed with IPO plans
items.summary: Sebi has provided observations for the IPOs of Carlsberg India, Matangi Rubber, Ujin Pharma, and TMC Transformer. Carlsberg's filing is under wraps, with specifics to be announced later. Matangi Rubber intends to issue 57.61 lakh new shares, complemented by an offer for sale. Ujin Pharma is looking to offer 1.18 crore shares, and TMC Transformer targets a substantial Rs 550 crore IPO, consisting solely of new issues.

items.title: Government extends RoDTEP export tax refund scheme by three months till December 31
items.summary: The government has extended the RoDTEP scheme until December 31, 2026, to support exporters amid challenges. This extension maintains the existing reimbursement rates and value caps for various export units. The RoDTEP scheme reimburses taxes and duties that are not refunded through other means, helping ease export costs. It has already covered over 10,700 tariff lines, with substantial disbursements made.

items.title: September LNG shipments through Hormuz hit highest since start of US-Iran war
items.summary: In September, the number of liquefied natural gas cargoes shipped through the Strait of Hormuz increased significantly. A total of 19 cargoes were shipped, primarily from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, marking the highest month since the US-Israel war started. Shipments included many vessels that operated with their transponders switched off for safety. Analysts express concerns about sustaining this level of exports amid potential military escalations from Iran.

items.title: Emami’s D2C bet faces a new test as buyback offers support
items.summary: Emami is betting on D2C brands and acquisitions to drive growth, but the bigger test is whether the portfolio can turn that growth into profits as the core business faces pressure.

items.title: Global bond market steadies after sharp sell-off
items.summary: Heavy selling this week pushed 10-year US Treasury yields to their highest level since 2002

items.title: SBI Research sees CPI inflation at 5.65% in Sept, above 6.5% in Oct-Nov
items.summary: SBI Research forecasts a rise in CPI inflation to around 5.65 percent in September. They expect it to exceed 6.5 percent during October and November. Inflationary pressures have broadened significantly since the last monetary policy meeting. Additionally, the weakening rupee poses further risks to economic stability. The Reserve Bank of India may adjust its GDP growth and inflation projections during the upcoming policy review.

items.title: Dividend, bonus, split, buyback, spin off in October: TCS, NMDC, PTC India, JSW Dulux among key corporate actions | List
items.summary: Corporate actions in October include spin-offs by Bhagyanagar India and Veranda Learning Solutions, dividends from TCS and NMDC, and stock splits by companies like Moldtek Technologies. Investors should hold stocks before record dates to qualify for various benefits and actions.

items.title: Department of Commerce extends RELIEF program timelines to support exporters facing geopolitical risks
items.summary: The Department of Commerce announced an extension of timelines under Component II of RELIEF - Resilience & Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation, which is government a measure dedicated to protect Indian exporters affected by extraordinary freight escalation. It would provide 95% risk coverage to exporters who obtain ECGC cover for upcoming shipments to the specified regions for certain cargo types.

items.title: India tourism growth faces skills crunch; workforce shortfall may hit 11 million by 2035: CBRE
items.summary: India's tourism industry could face a shortage of around 11 million workers by 2035 as demand for trained professionals struggles to keep pace with expanding hotels and emerging tourism segments, according to a CBRE Research report. The report highlighted gaps in specialised skills, worker retention and training capacity, particularly in tier-II and tier-III cities.

items.title: Experts' views: Can new HDFC Bank CEO-MD Anup Bagchi's appointment change fortunes of Sensex, Nifty, Bank Nifty indices?

items.title: Bitcoin leads crypto market rebound above $85K as short liquidations accelerate
items.summary: Crypto markets rose on Friday as total market capitalisation reached $3.042 trillion, with Bitcoin reclaiming $85,000 amid easing Treasury yields and a short squeeze. Bitcoin gained about 2%, while Ethereum held above $2,700. Investors now await US jobs data for clues on Treasury yields, the dollar and crypto’s next move.

items.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk: Rupee under pressure, inflation sticky: Will RBI be forced to rethink rates? Ankita Pathak, Ionic Asset
items.summary: With the Fed entering a tightening cycle, India faces a tougher monetary policy trade-off as the rupee remains under pressure and inflation shows signs of broadening. Ankita Pathak of Ionic Asset says RBI’s policy flexibility could narrow, while elevated US yields and a stronger dollar may weigh on Indian equities and capital flows.

items.title: Media, entertainment sector likely to see better growth in Q3FY27 on festive spending, content pipeline: Nuvama
items.summary: he media and entertainment sector is likely to see an improvement in spending and growth momentum in the December quarter, supported by a late Diwali, a stronger content pipeline and improving monetisation across digital, subscription and sports segments, Nuvama Research said in its October 1 sector preview.

items.title: Danish brewing giant Carlsberg’s India arm, 3 others get Sebi nod to float IPOs
items.summary: In a significant move for India's market, Sebi has greenlit IPOs for Carlsberg's local entity, TMC Transformers, Ujin Pharma, and Matangi Rubber. TMC Transformers aims to raise Rs 550 crores via new equity to establish a manufacturing plant. Ujin Pharma's offering includes fresh shares and a sale from its promoters, while Carlsberg joins other global firms in this venture. Matangi Rubber has also successfully navigated the IPO approval process.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares: How new MD-CEO Anup Saha's appointment can impact the stock - PL Capital decodes
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has approved Anup Saha as the new MD-CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank. Analysts at PL Capital remain optimistic, raising the target share price amid concerns over loan growth and capital utilisation.

items.title: Nitin Gadkari's ethanol challenge: 'Show me one damaged vehicle'; minister hits back at claims over blended petrol & reveals what farmers gained
items.summary: Nitin Gadkari defended the Centre's ethanol-blending programme at the Bihar Investor Summit 2026, rejecting claims that ethanol-blended petrol damages vehicles. He said millions of vehicles have been running on blended fuel since 2022 and highlighted the policy's potential to reduce fuel imports while creating additional income opportunities for farmers through ethanol production.

items.title: U.S. to send third carrier group to Mideast as Trump warns of new Iran strikes
items.summary: The U.S. is reportedly sending a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East, as Trump weighs resuming bombing Iran after the midterms.

items.title: Jyothy Labs has cash to buy growth. Why it isn’t rushing
items.summary: With ₹997 crore in cash and no debt, Jyothy Labs could use acquisitions to rebuild its portfolio after Henkel ended its Pril and Fa licensing deal. Instead, it is betting on new products and existing brands.

The recent appointment of Anup Bagchi as CEO provides hope for recovery, but challenges like deposit mobilization and investor confidence remain significant concerns for the bank's future.

items.title: South Korean President Lee warns of 'measures' against Ukraine over prisoner row, demands apology
items.summary: "As this is a matter concerning the honor of the Republic of Korea's people and nation, we cannot overlook it," he said.

items.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| ‘Desi to Videsi’: How GIFT City is changing the way Indians invest globally — Mustafa Pardiwala
items.summary: GIFT City is emerging as a gateway for Indian investors seeking global diversification, offering access to US stocks, ETFs and sectors such as AI and semiconductors. Mustafa Pardiwala of Mirae Asset Capital Markets (IFSC) explains how investors can start with smaller amounts, the role of ETFs, currency risk and fractional investing.

items.summary: Bond market moves keep investors on both sides of the Atlantic on edge ahead of another key jobs report.

items.title: Passenger accidentally touches emergency door of flight at Hyderabad airport; deboarded
items.summary: A 35-year-old passenger was deboarded from a flight at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in Hyderabad. The incident occurred as the flight was preparing for take-off to Kadapa on Thursday. While adjusting his seat, the passenger unintentionally touched the emergency exit door handle, activating the sensor alarm. The airline staff then deboarded him, and police were contacted to investigate the matter.

items.title: Jewelry giant Pandora is getting in on lab-grown diamonds and hoping a new Vietnam plant helps growth in Asia
items.summary: Pandora is expanding its manufacturing footprint beyond Thailand with a new $150 million Vietnam facility as the Danish jeweler eyes further growth across Asia.

items.title: Hospital stocks: can strong demand offset regulatory risks?
items.summary: The Supreme Court’s scrutiny of medicine mark-ups has raised concerns over hospital margins, even as robust demand for tertiary care continues to support the sector.

items.title: Suzuki asks India suppliers to move to 6-day, 20-hour operations by Sept 2027, sources say
items.summary: Suzuki Motor has requested Indian suppliers to implement a maintenance break for one day each week. This strategy aims to improve quality and prevent unscheduled production stoppages as output is expanded. Suppliers must sign declarations confirming that production lines will not operate continuously seven days a week. Amid rising demand in the domestic market, the company plans to boost car production to meet future targets.

items.title: Washington’s big crypto bill is stuck. The SEC is pushing ahead anyway
items.summary: The SEC has proposed new rules that would make it easier for investment advisers and regulated funds to hold cryptocurrencies on behalf of clients.

items.title: Global Markets | Japan's Nikkei retreats from 6-week high as investors lock in gains
items.summary: The Nikkei 225 index in Japan faced a downturn as investors engaged in profit-taking, displaying caution in the wake of earlier gains. This decline coincided with rising core inflation data from Tokyo, intensifying fears regarding interest rate hikes. Additionally, geopolitical tensions, particularly concerning the US-Iran situation, cast a shadow over market sentiment. Nevertheless, analysts remain optimistic about Japanese stocks, bolstered by positive feedback from the Bank of Japan's tankan survey.

items.title: Bajaj Finance to raise Rs 17,500 cr via QIP, preferential issue
items.summary: Bajaj Finance plans to raise up to Rs 17,500 crore through a Rs 11,700-crore QIP and Rs 5,800 crore warrant issue to promoter Bajaj Finserv. The fundraising requires shareholder approval; institutional investors will receive QIP shares while promoter warrants could help maintain Bajaj Finserv’s stake and limit dilution.

items.title: Bitget 'not expecting to recover a lot' from $388 million hack, CEO tells CNBC
items.summary: Bitget has frozen a tiny fraction of the $387.5 million stolen in last week’s hack, and restored much of its protection fund.

items.title: FCNR inflows cushion rupee, BoP; FII flows crucial for sustained external stability: Report
items.summary: Foreign currency non-resident inflows have significantly bolstered rupee stability and India's balance of payments.
